default_brand.override: An explicitly supplied brand guide takes precedence. Preserve its identity and review material adaptation.

direction: Choose the image the viewer should remember, then design its meaningful change.
One primary action at a time; supporting preparation may overlap without competing.
Guide toward the next destination before its main action; keep a shared UI shell when the same application changes pages.
Protect the reading anchor after content is fully visible, not from the first entrance frame.
Use sparse and dense compositions, scale and causal changes to create pace; do not animate only captions.
Choose a content-motivated punch moment; do not force a flip, zoom or phone into every film.
Fast passages may use images, objects or UI states instead of dense explanatory text.

media.casting_preference_when_people_are_neede: source-described Asian adults in contemporary urban editorial/commercial photography
avoid: AI-generated portraits presented as real photographs

audio.sfx: few, source-credited and tied to contact or result; never mask narration

learning: Record user acceptance separately from agent judgment; learn preferences and failures, not one permanent layout.
